definition.summary: Pre-norm causal decoder stack with grouped-query attention, RoPE with YaRN scaling and a gated FFN, as a template.
definition.description: A template contract: its meaning is the family of graphs its template `decoder-causal-yarn.json` denotes, one per assignment of `width`, `layers`, `heads`, `kv_heads`, `head_dim`, `inner`, `eps` and `precision`. Invoking it costs a consumer nothing beyond the primitives the template cites (§8.1); parameters, state and costs are derived from the expanded template (§4.6). The template locates its identities below a `weights_location_prefix` each instance supplies (§3.4): its names are the Llama-family names of `transformers` under the decoder (`layers.<n>.self_attn.q_proj.weight`, `layers.<n>.mlp.gate_proj.weight`, …), so an artifact stored that way, whatever its prefix, runs from the composite; an artifact named otherwise is written flat.
